name: Nihongo Master v1.3.0 - Road Fighter Overdrive (Hiragana Arcade Edition)
changelog: v1.3.0: Road Fighter Overdrive upgrade dedicated exclusively to Hiragana Fighter! Features full NES Road Fighter mechanics: dynamic track hazards (oil slicks with steering slip & traffic cones with warning flags), rival AI personalities (cruisers, weaving lane-changers, high-speed rivals, and heavy transport trucks with custom roof decals), slipstream drafting boost behind rivals (+10% speed with HUD draft indicator), kana match combo streaks (x2, x3, x4 multipliers & fuel rewards), near-miss bonus points with spark FX, and turbo heat management with overheat lockout. Enhanced graphics include steering body tilt/lean into turns, glowing brake lights, tyre smoke, speed lines, collision debris, and floating arcade score popups. Katakana Arcade and Secret Stage gauntlet mechanics remain 100% vanilla and completely isolated.
